s: Today we're talking about food and cooking.
Lena, are you ready to cook something delicious?
This weekend I'm planning a barbecue in my garden, and I need your help.
What are you going to cook?
Well, I want to add some new dishes this time.
Last summer my barbecue was just burgers, and my friends said, "Lena, add something different!"
When you plan a barbecue, it's nice to add variety.
First, I need to add beef to the shopping list.
Good beef is the heart of any barbecue.
I'll buy beef on Saturday morning.
Fresh beef makes a big difference.
But can I add a suggestion?
My neighbor makes the best beef kebabs.
He puts the beef on sticks with peppers and onions.
I'll add beef kebabs to the menu.
Now, should I add beans too?
Baked beans are a classic barbecue side.
My grandmother always said, "No barbecue is complete without beans." She would cook the beans slowly for hours.
Okay, beans are on the list.
And what about a vegetable option?
Some of our friends don't eat beef.
We should add aubergine to the menu.
I've never cooked aubergine on a grill.
You slice the aubergine, brush it with oil, and grill it.
The aubergine becomes soft and smoky.
Once you try grilled aubergine, you'll cook aubergine every week.
I'll add aubergine slices to the barbecue plan.
So far I need to buy beef, beans, and aubergine.

Because beans make the salad filling.
White beans with lemon and olive oil, so good!
My sister always adds beans to her salads, and now I add beans to mine too.
Now, when should we add the barbecue sauce?
Before grilling the beef, or after?
Never add the sauce too early, or it burns.
Grill the beef first, then add the sauce at the end.
If you add it too early, the sugar in the sauce burns and the beef tastes bitter.
And for the aubergine, do I add salt before grilling?
Yes, add a little salt to the aubergine slices and wait ten minutes.
The salt pulls out the water, so the aubergine grills better.
A well-salted aubergine is never bitter.
Add salt, wait ten minutes, then grill the aubergine.
Do I add anything to the beans?
Add a spoon of brown sugar and a little mustard to the beans.
Stir the beans and let them cook slowly.
Sweet beans, smoky beans, perfect barbecue beans.
